name: notch receptor 1

function.text: NOTCH1 encodes a transmembrane receptor whose proteolytic activation releases an intracellular signaling component that regulates transcription, cell fate, and differentiation.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to NOTCH1-related AOS spectrum disorder (autosomal dominant); Adams-Oliver syndrome 5 (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Somatic alterations are described across multiple tumor groups, including Mantle cell lymphoma; Pleomorphic dermal sarcoma; Lung squamous cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
